headline: Treat each W33 line as one local tetracode/E8 chart label, and declare a family of charts to overlap when their W33 lines share one point/A2 label. The maximal overlaps are the four line charts through a point, hence 40 tetrahedra. The resulting simplicial nerve has f-vector (40,240,160,40), boundary ranks (39,120,40), and homology (1,81,0,0).
homotopy_reading: The 40 maximal tetrahedra intersect one another only in vertices. After barycentric subdivision, each tetrahedron collapses relative to its four chart vertices onto the star from its point-barycenter. Doing this independently for all 40 tetrahedra yields exactly the 80-vertex, 160-edge W33 point-line Levi graph. Thus the chart-overlap nerve has the Levi graph homotopy type and its cycle rank is 160-80+1=81.
local_e8_boundary: The nerve records where local line charts would share their point/A2 labels. It does not yet supply Lie-algebra embedding maps between the E8 charts on those overlaps.
